desc:
💥 Ragdoll Chaos 💥

Ever wanted to microwave a dummy until it pops? Or dip one in acid until only bones are left? Do all that and more in our ragdoll simulator, full of dummies who react to you, each other and the world!

🧪 THE LAB 🧪

- Grab the free Serum Gun and mutate dummies into spiders, angels, giants, ghosts and more
- Mix serums into wild combos like Crab, Phoenix, Kaiju and Flytrap
- Ride your mutants and use their powers

🤺 REALISTIC PHYSICS 🤺

- Tear limb from limb with swords, saws and lasers
- Launch dummies with the force and watch them fly
- Fire them from cannons through breakable walls

⚡ 30+ WEAPONS ⚡

- Summon undead snowcorpses with the Frostblade
- Bring bad luck on others with the Unlucky Charm

🌋 LETHAL PLAYGROUND 🌋

- Sharks, meat grinders, an acid vat and a volcano that erupts when you feed it a dummy!
